import json

def solve(payload):
    # Split the payload into individual characters
    characters = list(payload)
    
    # Initialize an empty list to store the consecutive runs
    consecutive_runs = []
    
    # Iterate through the characters to find consecutive runs
    for i in range(len(characters)):
        count = 1
        while i + 1 < len(characters) and characters[i] == characters[i + 1]:
            count += 1
            i += 1
        consecutive_runs.append([characters[i], count])
    
    # Convert the list of consecutive runs to JSON and return
    return json.dumps(consecutive_runs)
